title: Iron Gospel
text: Repair rites have become commandments cut into the hands.
origin: A manufactorum catechism was branded into nerve and tool memory.
burdenText: Equipment repair services cost 1 additional Salvage.
adaptationText: Once per round after succeeding at Forge difficulty 10+, restore 1 charge to one eligible owned item.
trigger: Repair service or difficult Forge success.

effect.text: Iron Gospel recorded a costly repair rite.

relief: Purge this Scar at the Sable Machine Choir.
upside: A difficult Forge success can restore one charge.
